run.scope: Independent Grok re-audit of entropy sourcing and BIP-39 correctness in python-mnemonic at b57a5ad7. In scope: RNG in generate(), strength validation, checksum/encoding in to_mnemonic(), PBKDF2 in to_seed(). NOT: wordlists, SLIP-39, language heuristics. Cross-model counterpart to OSC-2026-0006.

findings.summary: No weakness found. generate() uses secrets.token_bytes (os.urandom-backed CSPRNG) with strength restricted to {128,160,192,224,256}. to_mnemonic enforces payload lengths and SHA-256 checksum bits. to_seed uses PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 with 2048 rounds and mnemonic+passphrase salt. Agreement with OSC-2026-0006.
